description: Authentic MIT Instrumentation Laboratory Apollo 11 Luminary 099 guidance computer. Transcribed rope-core memory ROM bank 31 decouples descent engine non-linear throttle bounds (10% LOWCRIT, 60% HIGHCRIT cavitation deadband) and P66 touchdown equations from the lunar landing guidance step. FalkorDB multi-agent swarm maps erasable memory provenance into verified, flight-ready control logic.

global_memory.description: Lunar Module instantaneous gross mass (descent stage + ascent stage, kg)

global_memory.label: FP
global_memory.description: Present measured Descent Propulsion System (DPS) thrust

global_memory.label: FC
global_memory.description: Guidance-demanded thrust magnitude computed by descent guidance polynomials

global_memory.label: FCODD

global_memory.label: LOWCRIT
global_memory.description: Minimum continuous descent engine throttle hardware stop (10% thrust limit)

global_memory.label: HIGHCRIT
global_memory.description: Maximum continuous throttle limit (60% thrust limit; avoids 60%-94% acoustic cavitation resonance zone)

global_memory.label: RADAR_ALT
global_memory.description: Landing radar slant-range and terrain clearance altitude register
